observations.original: A bright yellow compact oval submarine, blue forward upper window, red paired side pods, yellow rear fins and periscope, short skids and front lamps. Source silhouette and shading use sparse faceted primitives; equipment is duplicated in the upgraded source variant.
observations.target: Preserves the yellow/red/blue identity while adding broad rounded volume, thick layered window and pod lips, discrete metal fasteners, coherent hatch flange, deliberate shell panels, and a warmer controlled finish. Glass is saturated cyan blue with broad glossy value transitions.
observations.styleReference: Rounded golden frame with broad warm highlights and dimensional green facets; useful color separation and local creases without large dark zones.
observations.nativeSource: Original library contains S33_PROP_submarine_base.001 with 56 mesh/empty objects, baseline and upgraded body copies, per-object native clip actions, charge indicator. Hull has 42 vertices, pod cylinders 16, fins/skids largely 8; native rebuilding can improve silhouettes substantially.
observations.plannedStage1: Construct a rounded body/window/pods/periscope/lights/skids/propeller with coherent native motion, reserve useful body interfaces for the three future canonical separate pieces, and measure exact family clearances. Keep legacy effect sockets separate from physical mounting frames.
